summary: Prompt-time FILE pointers for the Claude recall hook (embedder step 4). injectSkipReason returns embedder-off / empty / slash-command / few-terms (reducer < 2 terms, e.g. 'go ahead'); otherwise fileInjection spawns `node dist/index.js find <reduced terms> --json --embed-stdin --rerank-budget-ms 800` (4 s timeout) with the full prompt written to the child's stdin, drops test paths from the rows (find --json includes tests), and renders the top 3 as `- path — defines …; named for …` plus a one-line gs hint. A library, not a wired entry point (kb-recall.mjs imports regex-engine first). Measured end to end on coldstart: ~0.7 s warm.
